description: Use this lightweight directory lookup to find clubs by location and facilities or resolve a club description, nearby landmark, or partial club name into candidate club_id, club_name, and provider values. Put only club-name wording in query; add location when an area was supplied. Use court_type for indoor/outdoor/covered courts, racket_rental for racket hire, and facility for a requested amenity. Preserve these filters when refining a search. Do not infer or pass provider from a club or brand-like name: provider is only an explicit booking-platform hint. If that hint conflicts with the directory, name resolution may return the canonical provider instead. It returns Zarvo club metadata, not live court availability. Follow with get_club for full metadata or get_availability for live slots at a selected provider club.

provider.description: Only filter by provider when the user explicitly names a booking platform. Never infer this from the club name.
